trust_root_resolution: Verifier MUST be invoked in TEST mode with --trust-root pointing to input/trust-root.json.
error_precedence_note: Manifest signature MUST verify successfully against the trust root. The manifest's content_hash MUST match the actual content bytes (the manifest was re-signed after the tamper was applied to the chain entry). A verifier that reports MANIFEST_HASH_MISMATCH or MANIFEST_SIGNATURE_INVALID for this fixture is non-conforming — it has either failed to re-derive the manifest's content_hash correctly or is incorrectly mapping a chain failure to a manifest code. The intended failure is isolated to chain_record_hash; acceptable_secondary_codes is empty to enforce strict primary code reporting.
failure_isolation_note: Single deliberate failure injection: the record_hash field on chain entry at sequence 2 has been modified by one byte. The chain's prev_hash linkage is recomputed downstream so chain_linkage remains technically valid relative to the tampered record_hash — only record_hash itself fails recomputation. The manifest content_hash is recomputed and re-signed after the tamper. All other layers MUST verify successfully; only chain_record_hash fails.
notes: Canonical tamper-detection test. This is the fixture demonstrated visually in the disappearance demo (`Keel_Demo_Script_2026-05-10.md` beat 4). Conformance Level 1 requires passing this fixture. A verifier that emits PASS for this fixture is fundamentally broken; a verifier that emits FAIL but with the wrong primary_failure_code is non-conforming on this vector.
